subject: rstan 2.8.0 - compile time error would crash R (buffer overflow detected)

messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: rstan 2.8.0 - compile time error would crash R (buffer overflow detected)
parts:
HI all,

It seems that a "syntax" error in my STAN script has caused stan_model to crash R.

in the following script, I think there is type mismatch between what is declared in data block and that in model block.
Changing the declaration in data block to:
real forecast_error [N_f}
seems to have solved the issue
> sessionInfo()
R version 3.2.1 (2015-06-18)
Platform: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu (64-bit)
Running under: Debian GNU/Linux 8 (jessie)

This problem affected rstan 2.7.0 as well

script:

data {
  int   <lower = 1> D;

  int<lower=0> N_f;                  // num of obs from forecast
  vector[D]   forecast_error [N_f];  // forecast error
}

transformed data {
  real<lower=1>  f_df;

  f_df <- N_f - 1;
}

parameters {
  real<lower=0> sigma_f;
}

model {
  forecast_error   ~ student_t (f_df, 0, sigma_f);
  sigma_f   ~ cauchy (0, 1);
}
